Name: (CP) Twiistrz Kitty Scarecrow
Author: Twiistrz
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/frixlHC.png[/img]

[b]What it do:
[/b]
This changes the scarecrow and all 8 of the rarecrows in the game to be cats on different pedestals/cat
climbing tower thingies. Its pretty darn cute. Who wouldn't want
ferocious guard kitties to keep the crows at bay?﻿


[b]Here's what changes:

[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/z7EHBg0.png[/img]﻿
[i]**The screenshot sort of makes it look like there's strange white pixels under the pedestal for some cats, but its just a compression problem
with my image, those spaces are transparent in game. - Jinxiewinxie

[/i][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][i]
[/i][i][i]To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.

[/i][/i][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract into your [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder
[*]﻿Run the game using [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[/list][i]
[/i]⚠️ If I didn't credit your work properly please send me a message and I will correct it asap.

⛔️ Copyright / Licensing: If any artist has an issue with pictures please send me a message and the mod will be taken down immediately.
